milestone.goal: Increment 1 — A working split view. Deliver: Tauri 2.x shell launching on Windows, file menu (Open/Save/Save As/Recent/Close via native dialogs), Monaco editor loading OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 YAML+JSON (language auto-detected from extension with UI override), debounced parse (200ms) updating a swagger-ui-react view with 'Try it out' disabled, last-good view retained on parse errors, schema validation on by default via monaco-yaml against the OpenAPI 3.1 schema cached in app_data_dir, red squiggles for violations, Save preserving line endings and encoding. No reader file, no copy-context command, no terminal — those are Increment 2 and 3. Perf: open Petstore 3.1 in <200ms; 10k-line spec responsive during Monaco highlight; keystroke-to-preview p95 <250ms. See product-brief.md for the full brief, architecture.md for lanes, ipc-contract.md for the IPC starting point. The GitHub repo is at https://github.com/BIoodHound/apicoord and already has an initial scaffold commit — do NOT force-push or re-init; commits land as fast-forwards on main.

director_notes.notes: 1: bundled schemas; drop remote fetch. 2: manual QA on Windows; no CI runner this increment. 3: hold the increment if we miss p95 <250ms — no silent degradation. 4: Save As writes original bytes for an unedited buffer. 5: session-only language override persists across Save As, resets on open-other. 6: mixed-EOL → save with majority EOL + status-bar note, no prompt. 7: yes, show encoding and EOL in the status bar. Procedural: architect applies m1 changes to architecture.md and fills ipc-contract.md as the first task of the build.

milestone.architecture_notes: Applied the increment's design to architecture.md (the procedural first build task). §5 is now the complete, authoritative IPC contract: 9 commands (ping, open_spec_dialog, open_recent, save_spec, save_spec_as, close_document, list_recent, get_schema, exit_app in commands/app.rs), 2 events (menu://action, recent://changed), {code,message} errors, and an allow-list rule where only open_recent takes a path. Webview permissions are only core:default, set-title and window-destroy. Doc terms map as: scene tree = React tree (§3), autoloads = singletons (§4), signals = Tauri commands/events (§5), physics layers = trust boundaries (§8), input actions = shortcuts with one owner each, decided by spike (a) (§7). There is no event-bus library (D17): Tauri events cross the process boundary and the Zustand store is the in-webview bus. Skeletons for state.rs, lib.rs wiring, the core module list, fileActions, the parse protocol and perf marks are written in §12 for T0 to create as-is, because the ownership hook (B2) blocks the architect from ipc-contract.md, package.json, tsconfig, vite.config, Cargo.toml, tauri.conf.json, capabilities and src/. Test run: all gates fail for environment reasons, so no code was tested. mvn fails on the missing backend/ dir, vitest is not found because node_modules is absent (B4), and cargo is not installed (B3). The correct gate (D18) is cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml plus npm test -- --run plus npm run typecheck from the project root.
